claim.claim-text: 1. A storage network comprising a plurality of storage systems, wherein each storage system comprises a storage grid structure (104) and at least one container handling vehicle (200,300), the storage grid structure is for storage of storage containers (106) and comprises at least one transfer column (119,120) and a horizontal top rail grid (108) upon which the container handling vehicle (200,300) may move in two perpendicular directions, the container handling vehicle is able to retrieve storage containers (106) from, and store storage containers in, the storage grid structure (104), and transport the storage containers on the top rail grid,

wherein the storage grid structure (104) comprises at least one horizontal transfer section (2); and the storage system comprises at least one container transfer vehicle (6) and transfer rails (110',111') forming a transfer rail grid (5) upon which the container transfer vehicle (6) may move in at least one horizontal direction, and - the transfer section (2) is arranged at a level below the top rail grid (108) and extends from an external side (12) of the storage grid structure (104) to a position below the at least one transfer column (119,120) and comprises at least a section of the transfer rail grid (5) upon which section the container transfer vehicle (6) may move in two perpendicular horizontal directions; and - the container transfer vehicles comprises a container carrier (38) for carrying a storage container (106) and a wheel arrangement (32a,32b) for moving the container transfer vehicle (6) in two perpendicular directions upon the transfer rail grid (5); and

wherein the at least one transfer column (119,120) extends from the top rail grid (108) to the transfer section (2), such that a storage container (106) may be transferred between the top rail grid (108) and the container carrier of the container transfer vehicle (6), and the transfer rail grids of the storage systems are connected to provide access for container transfer vehicles of each storage system to each of the storage grid structures and enable the transfer of storage containers between storage grid structures of the respective storage systems.

2. A storage network according to claim 1, wherein the storage grid structure (104) comprises vertical column profiles (102) defining multiple storage columns (105), in which the storage containers (106) can be stored one on top of another in vertical stacks (107), and the at least one transfer column (119,120), the column profiles are interconnected at their upper ends by top rails (110,111) forming the top rail grid (108), the container handling vehicle is able to retrieve storage containers (106) from, and store storage containers in, the storage columns (105).

3. A storage network according to claim 1 or 2, wherein at least the transfer rails (110',111') extending in one of two perpendicular directions of the transfer rail grid (5) are dual-track rails, such that two container transfer vehicles (6) may pass each other upon adjacent grid cells (122') of the transfer rail grid when moving in the one direction.

4. A storage network according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the transfer rails (110',111') are dual-track rails, such that two container transfer vehicles (6) may pass each other upon adjacent grid cells (122') of the transfer rail grid.

5. A storage network according to any of the preceding claims, wherein each of the container transfer vehicles (6) has a horizontal periphery fitting within the horizontal area defined by a grid cell (122') of the transfer rail grid (5).

6. A storage network according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the at least one transfer column (119,120) extends from the top rail grid (108) to the transfer section (2), such that a container handling vehicle (200,300) may transfer a storage container (106) between the top rail grid (108) and the container carrier of one of the container transfer vehicles (6).

7. A storage network according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the transfer rails (110', 111') or the transfer rail grid (5) provides at least two parallel transfer vehicle paths (7,7',7"), such that at least two of the container transfer vehicles (6) may pass each other in the transfer section (2).

8. A storage network according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the transfer rail grid (5) of one of the plurality of storage systems extends to a position arranged at a picking/stocking station or area, such that an operator/robot may access the content of a storage container when arranged on a container transfer vehicle (6), or a position arranged at a production facility, such as an assembly line or assembly station.

9. A storage network according to any of the preceding claims, wherein at least one of the storage grid structures comprises multiple transfer columns (119,120), wherein the respective transfer section (2) extends below the multiple transfer columns (119,120), preferably below multiple adjacent transfer columns.

10. A storage network according to any of the preceding claims, wherein an operator access passage (17) is arranged adjacent to at least one side of the transfer section (2) of at least one of the storage grid structures.
